edges.subject: CLN3
edges.quote: Juvenile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (JNCL, Batten Disease) is a childhood-onset, neurodegenerative, lysosomal storage disorder caused by mutations in the lysosomal gene CLN3.

edges.subject: juvenile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: Progressive cognitive decline is characteristic clinical feature.

edges.subject: CLN3
edges.quote: Loss of CLN3 caused defective synaptic vesicle release and reduced synaptic strength, reflecting impairments in both pre- and postsynaptic function in Cln3Δex7/8 mice.
